description:
Read supported services, required ride facts and the service-location time zone before collecting a new ride. Use get_customer_policy for purchase rules, quote_ride for price, or prepare_offer for an explicitly requested offer.

Language and location are independent: locale=de does not select Germany, and locale=en does not move the service elsewhere. Omit offerKey for the published default; otherwise use a known published selection and keep it across policy, quote and offer. Changing location requires reading its timeZone before interpreting pickup times.

This uncached read consumes no quote admission. available describes supported requests, not reserved vehicles; re-read before quoting. Correct invalid_request facts. unavailable leaves service scope unverified.

locale.description: Use the customer's requested language for text and booking links: en by default, de for German. Preserve it on retries; pickup times stay in the provider time zone.

offerKey.description: Optional existing published provider/supplier offer key. Selects its configured service location; it is not a customer bookingKey or bookingReference and grants no booking access.
